content.text:
All `legacy_fetch(` calls in `svc/m00.py` through `svc/m11.py` now call `fetch_v2(` with the same arguments. I removed `legacy_fetch` and its comment from `svc/api.py`. All twelve modules import cleanly. I didn't run any tests.

I also changed the `from svc.api import legacy_fetch` lines in the modules that had one to import `fetch_v2`, since the name no longer exists in `api.py`.

The only `legacy_fetch` left is the string `LOG = "migrating callers off legacy_fetch"` in `svc/m03.py`. It's log text, not a call, so I left it. Say if you want it reworded.
